title: Research Taste Exercises
focus_en: Suggests repeated research-taste exercises with quick, inexpensive mentor feedback, so researchers can practice judgment before completing full research projects.
focus_zh: 建议用导师快速、低成本的反馈反复练习科研判断，不必每次等待完整研究结束。
boundary_en: These are rough notes, not a validated training program. Mentor feedback is noisy and only a proxy for research quality; the exercises have not been shown to improve AI research taste.
boundary_zh: 这是粗略笔记，尚未验证训练效果。导师反馈有噪声，只是研究质量的代理；这些练习尚未被证明能改善 AI 的科研品味。

title: A Survival Guide to a PhD
focus_en: Gives practical advice on choosing promising problems, developing ideas, and executing research, based on a computer science and machine learning PhD experience.
focus_zh: 结合计算机科学与机器学习博士经历，讨论如何选择有前景的问题、发展想法并执行研究。
boundary_en: This is first-person advice from a computer science PhD experience, not a controlled study; its recommendations do not establish which interventions reliably improve human or AI research performance.
boundary_zh: 这是基于个人计算机科学博士经历的建议，并非受控研究；它不能确认哪些干预能可靠地提升人类或 AI 的科研表现。

title: You and Your Research
venue: Bellcore lecture; J. F. Kaiser transcript
focus_en: Urges researchers to choose important, tractable problems and build the habits, preparation, and working relationships needed to recognize and pursue opportunities.
focus_zh: 建议主动选择重要且可推进的问题，做好知识准备、养成工作习惯并建立协作关系，以识别和把握研究机会。
boundary_en: The linked Bellcore lecture is J. F. Kaiser's transcript, mirrored at UVA. Its personal observations are not controlled evidence or validated methods for training AI scientists.
boundary_zh: 链接为 UVA 镜像的 J. F. Kaiser 整理的 Bellcore 演讲稿。个人观察不是受控证据，也不是经验证的 AI 科学家训练方法。

title: Research Debt
focus_en: Calls accumulated complexity and poor communication research debt. Treats clearer explanations, better abstractions, and distillation as research contributions that help others understand and extend work.
focus_zh: 将积累的复杂性和沟通障碍称为 research debt，把清晰解释、改进抽象和知识提炼视为研究贡献，帮助他人理解与拓展研究。
boundary_en: This editorial argues for improving cumulative research. It provides no validated benchmark, causal estimate of distillation's benefits, or evidence that AI can make these contributions.
boundary_zh: 这篇文章主张改善研究积累，未提供经验证的 benchmark、知识提炼收益的因果估计，或 AI 能完成这些贡献的证据。

title: Quick thoughts on research
focus_en: Offers practical heuristics for finding worthwhile problems, developing tacit judgment, and learning by reviewing completed research.
focus_zh: 讨论如何发现值得研究的问题、积累难以言传的判断经验，以及通过复盘已完成研究来学习。
boundary_en: These are personal heuristics with acknowledged limits, not a systematic evaluation. Turning them into measurable training objectives or reliable AI learning methods remains open.
boundary_zh: 这些是作者承认有局限的个人经验，不是系统评价。如何将其转为可测量的训练目标或可靠的 AI 学习方法，仍待研究。

title: A Vision of Metascience: An Engine of Improvement for the Social Processes of Science
focus_en: Proposes institutions that learn how to support better research, using metascience to improve resource allocation and other social processes in science.
focus_zh: 提出建立能够学习如何支持更好研究的机构，用 metascience 改善资源分配等科学活动中的社会过程。
boundary_en: This is a conceptual agenda for institutional improvement rather than an empirical AI method; better social processes and stronger individual research agents require distinct mechanisms and evidence.
boundary_zh: 这是改进科研制度的概念性议程，而非实证 AI 方法；改善社会过程与增强个体 research agent 需要不同的机制与证据。
